data.name: Drop 9
data.detailed_description:
How It Works – A Glimpse Into the Underground

In Drop 9, survival isn’t just about staying alive—it’s about precision, timing, and mastering the underworld’s black-market logistics. Here’s how the job works, and why no two deliveries are ever the same:

1. Accepting Your Order

Head to any functional terminal in the underground to receive a new black-market contract. Each order comes encrypted with critical info—item ID, pickup deadline, recipient location, and the payout. Pay close attention: you’ll need to memorize codes, avoid decoys, and choose which orders are worth the risk.

2. Retrieving the Goods

Once you reach the stash site, crack the code. Some containers use rotating dials, others require rapid input under stress. Get it wrong, and it locks you out—or worse, alerts something else. Retrieve the contraband quickly, then vanish.

3. Hide from the Entity

You’re not alone down here. Something stalks the tunnels—drawn to light, sound, and fear. But the undercity is full of places to hide. Lockers, ventilation shafts, beds, stairwells. Timing and silence are your only allies.

4. Deliver Your Cargo

Each item is unique—not just in appearance, but weight, risk level, and destination. Some scream danger. Others whisper it. Learn to read the value vs. risk. Some shipments are tracked. Some… shouldn’t be touched at all.

5. Seal & Send

Once secured, lock the crate and head to the nearest Drop Point. Input the recipient code and send the cargo off. If you miss the pickup window, the vendor pulls out—and you’re left with nothing but regrets. Or worse.

Key Features

Encrypted Order System: Receive randomized, high-risk deliveries with limited intel.

Code-Based Lock Mechanics: Memorize or decrypt combinations under mounting pressure.

Stealth Survival Horror: Hide, outsmart, and survive—combat isn’t an option.

Time-Pressure Deliveries: Each second counts; miss the window, lose everything.

Atmospheric Worldbuilding: Explore flooded tunnels steeped in secrets and decay.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features a dark underground environment with unsettling themes. Players may encounter small amounts of blood, scattered human body parts, and decayed remains as part of the atmosphere. The game also contains themes of crime and smuggling. There is no explicit violence, sexual content, or strong language.
